S&L Connect ist ein auf Agrartechnik sowie Rasen- und Grundstückspflege spezialisiertes Unternehmen und offizieller Partner von John Deere. Als verlässlicher Ansprechpartner stehen wir für landwirtschaftliche Produktivität sowie hochwertige Maschinen und Dienstleistungen.

Mit einem engagierten Team an zehn Standorten in Südbrandenburg und Sachsen bieten wir fortschrittliche Lösungen, die gezielt auf die vielfältigen Anforderungen von Landwirten und Grundstückseigentümern ausgerichtet sind. Unsere Mitarbeitenden, Kunden und Partner bilden dabei die Grundlage unseres nachhaltigen Erfolgs.
Aufgaben
In deiner Rolle als Recruiter (m/w/d) bist du für die Gewinnung neuer Mitarbeitender und Auszubildender an unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen verantwortlich. Du begleitest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess von der Bedarfsplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Einstellung und stehst unseren Führungskräften als kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Darüber hinaus betreust du unsere Auszubildenden während ihrer gesamten Ausbildungszeit und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen auf Messen und Recruiting-Veranstaltungen.
Die Position kann an unseren Standorten Großenhain oder Ostrau ausgeübt werden. Regelmäßige Dienstreisen zu unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen gehören zu deinem Aufgabenbereich.

You don't need a perfect CV. You need the right skills.
This is not a role that filters by job title or tenure. It filters by what you can actually do.
We are looking for a recruiter who owns the full process — from the first Boolean search string to the signed offer, without
hand-holding, without process gaps, and without needing someone to define the search for them.
Skills are the filter, not biography. If you can demonstrate the capabilities below, we want to hear from you, regardless of how
your career path looks on paper.

You will be the driving force behind talent acquisition at a fast-growing, AI-powered HR Tech startup based in Berlin. This is an
internal recruiting role, not a staffing agency seat, not a volume-first environment.
You will own the complete hiring funnel: sharpen the role before searching, build and execute sourcing strategies, conduct
structured interviews, and manage stakeholders who need to be challenged, not just served.
Roles are thought of in terms of skill requirements, not job titles. The result is precision instead of volume. That's the standard
you'll work within and the standard you'll be held to.

A coordinator position waiting for candidates to come in
A reactive sourcing seat with no strategic mandate
A bureaucratic HR function with fixed playbooks and no autonomy

Full ownership of the recruiting process from identification to signed offer
A strategic partner seat, you challenge requirements, you advise, you deliver
A skill-first environment where your process quality matters more than your job title history
Your Skill Map
Core Skills are the central, non-negotiable capabilities of the role. Extended Skills are desirable additional competencies that
strengthen the profile but are not a knockout criterion.
Core Skills - KO Level
These are non-negotiable. If you cannot demonstrate these, this role is not a match.
Full-Cycle Recruiting Ownership
You independently drive the complete hiring process, from role clarification and sourcing strategy through structured
assessment to offer and close — without process gaps or handoffs mid-funnel.
What we look for: You can describe a search you ran end-to-end, including how you aligned the hiring manager on
requirements before searching, how you structured the funnel, and how you navigated blockers.
Active Sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter
You can build and execute complex Boolean search strings from scratch, not just apply standard filters. You understand
how to construct multi-layer queries, use operators, and adapt strings to market signals.
What we look for: You can write a Boolean string for a target role live, explain the logic behind it, and describe how you would
adapt it if initial results are too narrow or too broad.
Competency-Based Interviewing
You conduct structured interviews using a defined competency framework. Your candidate assessments are evidencebased, documented, and defensible, not impressionistic.
What we look for: You can explain how you assess a specific competency in an interview, what question structure you use, and
how you document the evidence. You distinguish between self-reported claims and demonstrated behavior.
Stakeholder Advisory
You challenge hiring managers when role definitions are unrealistic, market expectations are off, or process decisions
create risk. You align before searching, not after.
What we look for: You can describe a situation where you pushed back on a hiring manager's position and explain how you
built the case and navigated the outcome.
Data-Driven Recruiting
You read, interpret, and act on funnel KPIs, time-to-hire, source-to-screen conversion, offer acceptance rates. You use
data to make process decisions, not just report them.
What we look for: You can describe a recruiting funnel metric you tracked, how you interpreted it, and what process change it
drove.
Language Skills — Non-Negotiable
German at C2 / native-equivalent level, required for candidate conversations, stakeholder communication, and process
documentation in a German-speaking context. English at C1+ level, required for written and verbal communication in an
international team environment.
AGG note: Both language requirements are professionally justified by the candidate-facing and client-facing nature of the role
Strong Skills - Valued, Not KO
These strengthen your application but will not exclude you if absent.
Talent Pool Architecture: You systematically build, segment, and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring roles, not ad hoc lists
AI & Tech Tool Affinity: You have hands-on experience with modern ATS systems and AI-assisted sourcing or matching tools
Employer Branding Contribution: You can co-create job ad copy, LinkedIn content, or employer brand messaging, not just distribute it
Startup / Scale-Up Navigation: You have delivered results in environments where process, structure, and resources were all still being built
What You'll Work With
AI-powered recruiting infrastructure: The team you'll join builds and operates its own recruiting tooling. You will use it daily.
Modern ATS environment: Structured pipelines, documented stages, KPI tracking built in
LinkedIn Recruiter: Including Recruiter Lite or full seat, depending on search volume
Direct collaboration with a small, senior team, no layers, short decision paths
A technology-first environment where manual workarounds are the exception, not the norm
The operating model follows a clear sequence: first understand, then structure, then automate. Everyone working here works not in individual cases, but within a system.
What's On Offer
Hybrid working model: Berlin base, flexible execution
Real ownership: You design and run your own processes within a clear framework, no micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers: No approval chains for sourcing decisions or outreach copy
Growth context: You are part of building the internal recruiting capability, not maintaining a legacy setup
Purpose-driven work: Recruiting done properly: structured, skill-based, documented, and fair
Compensation: Salary is discussed transparently during the process, benchmarked against market data. No blanket figures
without basis. If this is relevant for you upfront, mention it in your application, we'll address it directly.
Our Hiring Process
We screen based on skills, not credentials. Here is what to expect:
Application review: A person reads every application, no automated filtering
Short intro call (20–30 min): Context, fit, mutual questions
Skills-based interview (60 min): Structured, competency-specific, with documented assessment
Optional: work sample or personality test: Role-relevant, time-boxed, focused on a real scenario
Final conversation + decision: Transparent feedback regardless of outcome
We aim to respond within 5 business days. If timelines shift, we communicate proactively.

The demand for home renovations has never been stronger, yet, it's surprisingly difficult for a new homeowner to renovate. It can take a decade to build up enough home equity and savings to pay for a major renovation. As a result, recent homeowners do a lot of financially-suboptimal things to compensate like borrow from their 401k, rack up credit card debt, and use high-interest personal loans. Or they just live unhappily for years in a home that doesn't meet their family's needs.
But by completing a major renovation, homeowners are increasing the value of their home. Professional real estate investors leverage this After Renovation Value (ARV) to roll the increase in value into new properties all the time. But there hasn't been a great way for homeowners to take advantage of this. If homeowners had an ability to borrow against the ARV, they could increase their borrowing power up to 10x.
To meet this need, RenoFi created a platform that enables homeowners to borrow funds from RenoFi approved lenders in the form of the first home equity loan purpose-built for renovations! Unlike standard home equity loans, RenoFi Loans use the value of your home post-renovation which lets you borrow the most money at the best possible terms. RenoFi is creating a full suite of renovation loan products to better suit the needs of today’s homeowners!
For homeowners, RenoFi makes it possible to renovate years earlier than might be otherwise feasible. For contractors, we empower the financing of renovations at the point of sale, reducing instances of scope reduction, and ensuring prompt payment.

Our lender partners, most often credit unions, rely on RenoFi's platform to generate loans, create efficiencies, and grow membership. The lenders pay RenoFi for the new loans, which allows us to offer our services to homeowners for free. RenoFi is truly a win-win-win for everyone involved.
RenoFi is backed by some of the best startup investors in the world, including First Round Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Canaan Partners.

s.h: WE ARE A GLOBALLY DISTRIBUTED TEAM
s.t:
RenoFi has been built from the start as a fully distributed team with an intentional focus on growing a strong team and culture that spans timezones and nationalities. Here's one fun example!
Please highlight any prior experience working remotely when applying. US or GMT-adjacent timezones will be prioritized.
RenoFi offers competitive cash and equity compensation. Some benefit offerings will vary from country to country. In the United States, we offer competitive health and retirement plans. All staff across the globe enjoy a flexible vacation policy.

Kirby Bates Associates’ consultants are specialists focused exclusively on the healthcare executive recruitment market. With hundreds of years of combined experience and extensive professional networks, KBA provides a personalized, professional and confidential service designed to ensure that candidates are matched with the best possible opportunities.
Our inclusive search methodology is designed to create a level playing field and keep implicit bias in check so that the most qualified candidates advance.
Kirby Bates Associates is seeking an experienced Executive Recruiter to join our executive search team and help connect exceptional healthcare leaders with organizations where they can make a meaningful impact.
This is an opportunity for an accomplished recruiter who enjoys the detective work of finding outstanding talent, the relationship-building required to engage senior-level candidates, and the satisfaction of helping healthcare organizations identify their next generation of leaders.
As an Executive Recruiter at Kirby Bates Associates, you’ll be an integral member of each search team—partnering closely with our Vice Presidents and Associate Vice Presidents to develop sourcing strategies, identify and engage highly qualified candidates, assess talent, and create an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through placement.
If you are curious, resourceful, highly organized, and passionate about healthcare and people, we’d like to meet you.

Find Exceptional Healthcare Leaders
You’ll develop and execute thoughtful research and sourcing strategies for executive searches, using LinkedIn, professional networks, databases, associations, Boolean search techniques, and other resources to uncover outstanding candidates—including talented leaders who may not be actively looking for their next opportunity.

s.h: You’ll work closely with each search team to
s.t:
Develop targeted search and research strategies.
Identify and build pipelines of qualified executive candidates.
Use LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, professional associations, databases, directories, and other resources creatively and effectively.
Identify gaps in a sourcing strategy and recommend new approaches.
Maintain accurate, current candidate information in our applicant tracking system.
Keep the search team informed of progress, market feedback, and emerging challenges.
Turn Prospects Into Engaged Candidates
Finding great people is only the beginning. You’ll build relationships with prospective candidates, introduce them to compelling opportunities, and help determine whether there is a strong fit between the leader and our client organization.

Conduct thoughtful outreach to prospective candidates and convert qualified prospects into active candidates.
Screen candidates against established criteria and develop a clear understanding of their experience, accomplishments, credentials, and career goals.
Identify potential concerns or gaps and communicate them effectively to the search team.
Prepare candidates for interviews with Kirby Bates search leaders.
Maintain regular communication so candidates remain informed and engaged throughout the search process.
Ensure resumes and candidate materials meet Kirby Bates standards for accuracy, content, and presentation.
Help coordinate client interviews and candidate logistics.
Support ongoing follow-up with successfully placed executives during their first year.
Be a Trusted Search Partner
You’ll work collaboratively with multiple members of the Kirby Bates team and contribute insight, judgment, and information throughout the search process.
That means communicating proactively, meeting commitments, maintaining exceptional attention to detail, and ensuring that both candidates and colleagues have the information they need when they need it.
Although this is a remote position, participation in occasional in-person client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, seminars, and industry events may be required.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role isn’t simply measured by activity. It’s about finding the right people—and engaging them effectively.

s.h: Two important measures of success are
s.t:
Speed to qualified candidates: You efficiently translate a search strategy into a strong slate of qualified prospects and candidates.
Candidate quality and engagement: The candidates you develop meet established search criteria and remain informed, interested, and engaged throughout the process.
We’re looking for an experienced recruiter who combines persistence and curiosity with excellent judgment, communication skills, and attention to detail.

s.h: Bachelor’s degree; a healthcare-related field is preferred.
s.t:
Minimum of five years of experience in retained executive search or healthcare recruitment.
Demonstrated ability to identify and engage candidates through LinkedIn and other sourcing channels.
Strong Internet research and Boolean search skills.
Experience using recruiting databases and research tools such as ZoomInfo.
Experience working with applicant tracking systems; Bullhorn experience is preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Teams, and Excel.
Excellent writing, proofreading, and editing skills, with the ability to produce polished, client-ready work.
Excellent verbal communication and active-listening skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work effectively with multiple leaders in a collaborative, matrixed environment.
Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.
Self-motivation and discipline to thrive in a remote work environment.

s.h: Ability to meet applicable E-Verify requirements.
s.t:
A Master’s degree in Nursing, Human Resource Management, or another relevant discipline is a plus.
The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here
You may be a great fit if you’re someone who gets genuine satisfaction from finding the person others couldn’t find.
You’re naturally curious. You enjoy researching people, organizations, and career paths. You know that great recruiting is about more than sending messages—it requires listening carefully, asking insightful questions, building trust, exercising good judgment, and following through.
You’re comfortable working independently but enjoy being part of a highly collaborative search team. You care about the details because you understand that every candidate interaction reflects on Kirby Bates and our clients.
And you want your work to have meaning. Helping healthcare organizations find exceptional leaders gives you exactly that opportunity.

How we work matters as much as what we accomplish. At Kirby Bates Associates, our culture is grounded in three core values:
Others First — Put others before self.
We approach our clients, candidates, colleagues, and communities with a spirit of service.
Wisdom — Do the wise thing.
We exercise sound judgment, act with integrity, and strive to make thoughtful decisions.
Growth — Keep getting better.
We remain curious, welcome feedback, learn from experience, and continually improve our work.

# Recruitment Coordinator 80 - 100% #
Mit rund 1400 Mitarbeitenden ist Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung (JuWe) das grösste Amt innerhalb der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern und für den Straf- und Massnahmenvollzug sowie für die Durchführung verschiedener Haftarten verantwortlich. Unsere Mitarbeitenden aus rund 40 Berufen unterstützen und fördern die Wiedereingliederung straffällig gewordener Menschen und setzen sich wirksam und fortschrittlich für eine sichere und gerechte Gesellschaft ein.
Der Fachbereich Human Resources gehört zur Amtsleitung. Die rund 30 Mitarbeitenden gestalten und verantworten sämtliche Aufgaben des Personalmanagements - von der Gewinnung, Beratung und Entwicklung der JuWe Mitarbeitenden über personalrechtliche und administrative Dienstleistungen bis hin zu HR-Controlling und strategischer Personalsteuerung.
Als Recruitment Coordinator sorgst du dafür, dass unser Recruiting im Hintergrund professionell, effizient und zuverlässig funktioniert. Du bist eine zentrale administrative Drehscheibe im Rekrutierungsprozess und unterstützt unser Team Rekrutierung & Assessment mit Organisationstalent, Genauigkeit und Überblick.
Wir suchen **per 1. Oktober 2026** oder nach Vereinbarung (befristet bis Ende 2028) eine Person, die Ordnung, Struktur und einen reibungslosen Ablauf liebt.
### Deine Aufgaben ###
* Du übernimmst die administrative Abwicklung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses: von der Stellenausschreibung bis zur Anstellung
* Du erstellst und publizierst Stelleninserate, verwaltest Bewerbungen im Bewerbermanagementsystem und sorgst für eine lückenlose Dokumentation
* Du bereitest Anstellungsunterlagen vor und stellst die fristgerechte Abwicklung sicher
* Du unterstützt die Leitung Rekrutierung & Assessment bei administrativen Aufgaben, statistischen Auswertungen sowie ausgewählten Aufgaben im Bereich Talent Acquisition
* Du arbeitest bei der Weiterentwicklung von administrativen Prozessen, Vorlagen und Tools mit
* Du stellst eine professionelle, freundliche und serviceorientierte Kandidatenkommunikation sicher
### Dein Profil ###
* Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Ausbildung und über das Zertifikat HR-Assistent oder HR Sachbearbeiter/in
* Idealerweise bringst du Berufserfahrung in einer administrativen Funktion, vorzugsweise im HR- oder Recruiting-Umfeld, mit
* Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert, exakt und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick
* Du hast Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten und an klaren Prozessen
* Du bist IT-affin und gehst sicher mit MS Office sowie idealerweise mit Bewerbermanagementsystemen um
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Du bist eine dienstleistungsorientierte, diskrete und teamfähige Persönlichkeit
### Unser Angebot ###
* Ein grossartiges, hilfsbereites und humorvolles Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt
* Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem spannenden und vielseitigen Umfeld
* Eine fundierte Einarbeitung in dein neues Aufgabengebiet
* Ein breites internes und externes Weiterbildungsangebot
* Dein zukünftiger Arbeitsort liegt zentral am Bahnhof Altstetten
### So wirst du Teil von uns ###
1. Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool
2. Online-Assessment
3. Virtuelles oder persönliches Kennenlernen
4. Schnuppertag sowie ein persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem R&A Team
5. Finaler Entscheid
**Deine Bewerbung**
Mach mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Deiner beruflichen Laufbahn und schick uns Deine Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool. Wir freuen uns auf Dein Dossier!
Hast Du Fragen? Gerne ist das Team Rekrutierung & Assessment, unter bewerbung-juwe@ji.zh.ch für Dich da.
Das JuWe setzt im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses ein Online Assessment ein. Weitere Informationen zu unserem Rekrutierungsprozess und zur Anstellung im JuWe sind unter Arbeiten bei JuWe | Kanton Zürich (zh.ch) zu finden.

**Votre mission**
Rattaché\-e à la Direction des Ressources humaines, vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités de la gestion administrative et technique du personnel. **Vos responsabilités principales**
* Encadrer, organiser et piloter le travail d'une équipe d'une douzaine de collaborateur\-trices au sein des Ressources humaines,
* élaborer, proposer et coordonner la mise en œuvre d'outils visant une gestion efficiente des processus administratifs RH,
* superviser les domaines clés dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs et collaboratrices, tels que le système salarial, la gestion du temps, le suivi des absences, l'accueil RH, la prise de rendez\-vous médicaux d'aptitude,
* garantir la conformité des pratiques avec les règles internes ainsi qu'avec la législation en vigueur,
* structurer, formaliser et déployer les procédures, marches à suivre et processus liés à l'administration RH,
* assurer la supervision complète du domaine des assurances sociales,
* produire, analyser et suivre les données et statistiques relatives aux assurances sociales et aux activités RH,
* veiller à l'optimisation continue des processus et à la qualité des prestations fournies par le service
**Votre profil**
* Master en Ressources humaines, droit, économie, sciences sociales ou formation jugée équivalente,
* certification complémentaire souhaitée (brevet fédéral RH/assurances sociales/droit du travail),
* expérience confirmée d'au moins 10 ans dans les Ressources humaines, dont 3 ans dans une fonction d'encadrement,
* bonnes connaissances en gestion administrative RH, assurances sociales et législation du travail,
* capacité à fédérer et motiver une équipe pluridisciplinaire,
* forte orientation résultats, autonomie et esprit d'initiative,
* sens développé de l'organisation, rigueur et résistance au stress,
* capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés (direction, partenaires sociaux, autres services, collaborateur\-trices),
* maîtrise parfaite du français (oral et écrit), bonnes connaissances en allemand et/ou en anglais sont des atouts,
* maîtrise des outils RH informatiques (SAP HR, HCM ou équivalents) et bonne aisance digitale
**Êtes\-vous intéressé\-e?**
Nous espérons que ce poste saura éveiller votre intérêt et vous donnera envie de contribuer au déploiement de notre stratégie multimodale qui définit la vision globale en matière de mobilité à long terme !
Les équipes des Ressources humaines portent une culture engagée et responsable, au service des enjeux publics, au plus près des équipes, créant les conditions d'un engagement durable, d'un environnement de travail de qualité et d'un bien\-être réel pour favoriser la présence, l'implication et la mobilisation.
